fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS security rules blocking unexpected TAU/ATTACH with unknown TAI.
Enable 5G NAS integrity protection for all IMSI-based procedures.
Set NAS timer T3450 to 10 seconds to reject delayed responses from rogue BS.
Implement NAS rule requiring valid 5G authentication before TAU/ATTACH.
Configure RAN to drop UE with mismatched TAI list in NAS messages.
Enforce NAS counter check for duplicate TAU/ATTACH attempts per IMSI.
Use NAS rule to block TAU/ATTACH with unrecognized PLMN-ID.
Monitor NAS KPI for abnormal TAU/ATTACH frequency per UE.
Deploy NAS-based IMSI catcher detection via TAI mismatch alerts.
Enable NAS logging for all unmasked IMSI-related procedures.
